info.schedule: First Tuesday monthly (about April to October), 100 Ridley Ave, LaGrange
info.note: Monthly lists include the opening bid. Results are not posted; the excess funds list shows parcels that sold above it.

auction.venue: On the steps before the courthouse door (Troup County government and courts building)
auction.time: First Tuesday of the month, between 10:00 am and 4:00 pm
auction.payment: Cash, or a cashier's or certified check from an FDIC or FSLIC insured institution; credit and debit cards are accepted with a convenience fee. Payment is due by 2:00 pm on sale day.
vital: Buyer beware sale with no guarantees. Mobile homes do not convey with the property, and the county advises against buying sight unseen.
These are non-judicial sales. The opening bid covers all taxes, penalties and costs, and a recognized bid is binding.
The posted list is a courtesy list that can change, and bid amounts can change with pending costs. A list is available at the office about two weeks before the sale.
The tax deed is executed 4 to 6 weeks after the sale and is not a fee simple deed.

The owner may redeem for 12 months by paying the bid plus taxes paid plus 20% for the first year and 10% for each year after. The buyer waits one year and one day to start foreclosing the right of redemption.
On redemption the buyer must sign a quitclaim deed within 7 days and record it within 10 days. The Tax Commissioner may set a sale aside for irregularities with a full refund.
auction.confirmed: Checked 2026-10-03. Post updated 2026-09-22 with the October 6, 2026 list. The page says only 'on the steps before the courthouse door'; 100 Ridley Avenue is the county government and Tax Commissioner address, and no bidder registration procedure is published.
